title: Curb Appeal Upgrade Ideas Florida | Stone Entryway Transformation
description: See how this Florida home improved curb appeal with a stone entryway upgrade using Northern Slate. Real before and after.
text:
Florida Curb Appeal Upgrade: Transforming a Front Entryway with Stone
See how a simple stone upgrade transformed this home’s entrance into a clean, high-end focal point without major construction.

Kyle Reichrath

Project Coordinator

Hi, I’m Kyle, and I worked with this homeowner in Florida on a targeted exterior upgrade.

The home itself was in great shape, but the front entryway felt plain compared to the rest of the property. It didn’t have the visual impact or character you’d expect when approaching the home.

They weren’t looking to redo the entire exterior—they just wanted to upgrade the part of the home people notice first.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

A Complete Curb Appeal Upgrade Without a Full Remodel
From Outdated Stucco to Modern Stone • Installed Over the Old Stucco

A focused upgrade can completely change how a home feels from the outside.By adding stone around the entryway, this project created a stronger focal point and a more finished, high-end look—without touching the rest of the exterior..

✅ Installed directly over existing stucco

✅ No demolition required

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

A Simple Upgrade That Completely Changed the First Impression
A simple upgrade turned this builder-grade exterior into a clean, custom look adding depth, contrast, and a high-end finish without major construction.

Before

The Goal

- Entryway felt plain and unfinished

- Lacked contrast and visual interest

- Didn’t create a strong first impression

- Wanted a more polished, high-end look

- No interest in a full exterior remodel

After

The Solution

- Add depth and texture around the entry

- Frame the front door as a focal point

- Create contrast against the stucco

- Improve curb appeal without major changes

- Achieve a finished, custom look

What Does a Curb Appeal Upgrade Like This Cost?

Most homeowners are surprised how affordable focused upgrades like this can be. Projects like this typically range between $2,500–$5,500, depending on the size of the entryway and layout.

Try Visualizer Get Project Planning Guide

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels, Corners

- Color: Northern Slate

- Install: Over Existing Stucco

Will This Work on Stucco Like This Project?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface. To install over stucco, simply use Tapcon screws.

Why Not Just Paint or Refinish the Entryway?

Adding GenStone to the entry elevates the curb appeal by adding texture that both compliments the existing color palette and contrasts the flat areas.

Northern Slate Color Guide

This color was chosen to create contrast against the lighter exterior while maintaining a natural stone look that fits the Florida style.
